title: Local AI on Surface Laptop Ultra

slides.title: Hardware Stack
slides.takeaway: NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X with 20 cores
slides.notes: The device uses NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X with 20 CPU cores. GPU memory is distinct from system RAM. Never add them together.

slides.title: Memory Views

pairs.concept: GPU memory is like a car's trunk
pairs.analog: Only holds what the GPU needs

pairs.concept: System RAM is like the car's cabin

pairs.analog: Trunk and cabin are separate spaces

slides.notes: GPU memory (64,000 MiB) is distinct from system RAM (128 GB). Never combine these views. This is a critical distinction for local AI performance.

slides.title: Local Runtimes
slides.takeaway: llama.cpp and Foundry Local support CUDA
slides.notes: Both runtimes support CUDA on this device. This allows for efficient local model inference using the GPU.

slides.title: Model Catalog
slides.notes: The device hosts 28 open models, totaling 315 GiB on disk. These are all local and accessible without cloud calls.

slides.title: Throughput
slides.takeaway: Tokens per second like a typing speed

pairs.analog: Like typing 140 words per second with 4 fingers
Like typing 72 words per second with one finger
Like using shortcuts to type faster

slides.notes: Throughput numbers are from Local-AI-Bench on a shared machine. Qwen3-Coder 30B achieves 140 tokens/s across 4 streams, and 72/s single stream.

slides.title: MoE vs Dense Models
slides.takeaway: MoE models activate fewer experts per token

data.verdict: MoE models are faster for decoding

slides.notes: MoE models activate only a few experts per token, making them decode several times faster than dense models of similar size.

slides.title: Model Sizing Bands
slides.notes: Model sizing bands are planning estimates. S-band models are lightweight, XL-band are for heavy tasks.

slides.title: Code Generation & RAG
slides.takeaway: Local code gen and internal docs
slides.notes: The system runs code generation and retrieval over internal engineering documents locally, without cloud calls.

slides.title: Hybrid Routing
slides.notes: Sensitive and frequent tasks (code, internal docs) route to the local lane. Heavier reasoning can go to cloud models.

slides.title: Made on Device
slides.notes: This deck was generated on the Surface Laptop Ultra using Qwen3-Coder 30B through llama.cpp, with no cloud calls.

slides.title: Pilot Ask
slides.notes: Zava invites 10 developers for a 2-week pilot to measure acceptance rate, latency, and developer experience.
